# Prezi

> Prezi is an AI-powered presentation software platform that enables users to create engaging, non-linear presentations with templates, collaboration tools, and integrations for business, education, and personal use.

Prezi offers comprehensive presentation creation solutions across multiple use cases including business presentations, educational content, and student projects. The platform features AI-assisted design, video integration, and enterprise-grade collaboration with SOC2 compliance for teams.
